title: Diana Vreeland and Grace Mirabella: A betrayal on glossy paper
subhead: 'Sewn and torn' (5/6). Love stories and friendships can sometimes end badly, even in the world of fashion. For nearly a decade, the flamboyant Diana Vreeland imposed her vision of style in the pages of Vogue, with the support of Grace Mirabella. That is, until 1971, when her loyal assistant dethroned her and ushered in a new era for the magazine.

title: Environmental amnesia: How we can't even remember the lost biodiversity of yore
subhead: While we can recall car windshields covered with dead insects after a drive, what do we know about wolves that once roamed the countryside in the Middle Ages, or salmon swimming in the Seine in the 19th century? This gradual forgetting of what was once a teeming natural world prevents us from protecting today's nature.

title: 'I'll pay for a breast. Even both, if you want': The costs, big and small, of breast surgery in the private sector
subhead: 'My Breasts and Me' (5/5). In France, one out of every two patients chooses the private sector for breast reconstruction.
